# Pawn Island Academy

> Private online chess coaching with Matthew Freeman, 2024-25 Rhode Island State Champion.

Pawn Island Academy helps scholastic players, adult improvers, families, and tournament players build clearer chess decisions through private coaching, game review, calculation training, openings, endgames, and tournament preparation. Coaching is remote-first — online for students anywhere — with limited in-person lessons in the greater Fredericksburg, Virginia area.
